description: NaAg(NO₂)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to two N and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.47 Å) and one longer (2.52 Å) Na-N bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent Ag sites. In the first Ag site, Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ag-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.51 Å. In the second Ag site, Ag is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (2.14 Å) and one longer (2.20 Å) Ag-N bond length. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.22 Å) and one longer (1.29 Å) N-O bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.18 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) N-O bond length. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ag and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) N-O bond length. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ag and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.21 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) N-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one N atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one N atom.
